about: MT-Bench (Zheng et al. 2023) released judgments, built by mk_data.py. keys: [question, turn, model i, model j (i<j), GPT-4 pair verdict both orders (0 i wins, 1 j wins, 2 tie, -1 none), 1 if that tie is an order disagreement, GPT-4 single score i, score j (-1 none), leaderboard-run verdict with i shown first, with j shown first (-1 none), words in i answer, words in j answer]. votes: [key index, human verdict, voter index].
